themes.evidence: We believe our first responsibility is to the patients, doctors and nurses, to mothers and fathers and all others who use our products and services.
We must provide an inclusive work environment where each person must be considered as an individual.
We must respect their diversity and dignity and recognize their merit.
We must constantly strive to provide value, reduce our costs and maintain reasonable prices.
We must maintain in good order the property we are privileged to use, protecting the environment and natural resources.
We must help people be healthier by supporting better access and care in more places around the world.
When we operate according to these principles, the stockholders should realize a fair return.

linguistic_shift: The language emphasizes a broader range of responsibilities, including community and environmental stewardship, alongside traditional business and employee values.
